Unleash Your Strength at PowerFit Gym

Premier strength training and fitness facility in Springfield

View Membership Plans

Our World-Class Facilities

Free Weights & Barbells

Complete range of dumbbells from 5 lbs to 150 lbs, Olympic barbells, and power racks for serious lifters.

Cardio Equipment

State-of-the-art treadmills, ellipticals, rowing machines, and stationary bikes with individual TV screens.

Strength Machines

Latest Smith machines, cable stations, and leg press equipment for all fitness levels.

Functional Training Zone

Battle ropes, kettlebells, medicine balls, TRX systems, and agility equipment for dynamic workouts.

Personal Training

Certified trainers available for one-on-one coaching and customized workout programs.

Locker Rooms & Showers

Clean, secure facilities with premium toiletries, towel service, and premium lockers.

Membership Plans

Choose the perfect plan for your fitness journey. All memberships include access to all facilities and classes.
